parsed.name: TTi QL355TP 可编程多路直流电源
parsed.name_en: TTi QL355TP Programmable Multi-Output DC Power Supply
parsed.description: 用于实验室供电的台式可编程直流电源，支持多个输出通道的开关控制，并可设置与读取电压、电流及限流参数，适合电子器件测试、原型验证和实验系统供电。
parsed.description_en: A bench programmable DC power supply for laboratory use. It supports enabling multiple output channels and setting or reading voltage, current, and current-limit parameters, making it suitable for electronics testing, prototyping, and powering experimental setups.

actions.description: 初始化电源通信并准备设备使用。
actions.description_en: Initialize communication with the power supply and prepare it for use.

actions.description: 重新初始化电源连接与设备状态。
actions.description_en: Reinitialize the power supply connection and device state.

actions.description: 向电源发送底层控制命令。
actions.description_en: Send a low-level control command to the power supply.

actions.description: 向电源发送查询命令并获取响应。
actions.description_en: Send a query command to the power supply and get the response.
Read response data returned by the power supply.

actions.description: 打开或关闭指定输出通道，可作用于 OP1、OP2、AUX 或全部通道。
actions.description_en: Enable or disable a selected output channel, including OP1, OP2, AUX, or all channels.

actions.description: 读取电源名称或型号标识。
actions.description_en: Read the power supply name or model identification.

actions.description: 读取指定输出通道（OP1 或 OP2）的输出电流。
actions.description_en: Read the output current of the selected channel (OP1 or OP2).

actions.description: 读取指定输出通道（OP1 或 OP2）的输出电压。
actions.description_en: Read the output voltage of the selected channel (OP1 or OP2).

actions.description: 读取指定输出通道（OP1 或 OP2）的电压设定值。
actions.description_en: Read the configured voltage setpoint of the selected channel (OP1 or OP2).

actions.description: 读取指定输出通道（OP1 或 OP2）的限流设定值。
actions.description_en: Read the current-limit setting of the selected channel (OP1 or OP2).

actions.description: 设置指定输出通道（OP1 或 OP2）的输出电压。
actions.description_en: Set the output voltage of the selected channel (OP1 or OP2).

actions.description: 设置指定输出通道（OP1 或 OP2）的电流限制。
actions.description_en: Set the current limit of the selected channel (OP1 or OP2).

actions.description: 复位电源的跳闸或保护状态。
actions.description_en: Reset the power supply trip or protection state.
